title: Quiet Storm
tagline: Slow-burn vocals, soft keys and late-night feeling.
summary: Quiet storm is a slow, atmospheric branch of soul and R&B built around intimate vocals and gently unfolding arrangements. It often feels like the after-hours version of the radio: warm synths, patient rhythm and a sense of calm confidence. The style made space for mood and feeling without losing the pull of a good hook.

pillars.name: Marvin Gaye
pillars.why: Marvin Gaye shaped a deep, intimate singer-songwriter approach that defined the quiet-storm mood.

pillars.name: The Isley Brothers
pillars.why: The Isley Brothers brought a smooth, luxurious balance of soul and rhythm that made the style feel expansive.

pillars.name: Sade
pillars.why: Sade gave the form a cooler, more minimal elegance that still felt emotionally direct.
